text:
sasha: FYI customer reported doubled tokens when they reconnect mid-stream; looks like a toolcall executed twice after client truncated the stream.

ravi: logs?

sasha: paste: 
``` 
router: stream init session=aa1
backend: toolcall translate tokens=95 success
client: connection closed (early-eof)
client: reconnect session=aa1_r
router: resume -> backend
backend: toolcall translate tokens=95 success
```

maia: no idempotency header on toolcall = problem. Also billing marks toolcall tokens confirmed immediately.

leo: proposal: emit PROVISIONAL billing event for mid-stream toolcalls and only CONFIRM on final ack/stream-close. Also carry X-Toolcall-Id so dedupe is deterministic.

ravi: need TTL for provisional (we have 5m snapshot tombstone). We'll add reconcile job for existing spikes. Also metric increments for provisional/confirmed/dedupe.

maia: console: show provisional vs confirmed token counts in trace UI so ops can see spikes.

leo: router changes: forward/generate X-Toolcall-Id, propagate orig_session_id on resume, local cache dedupe 30s. Feature-flag rollout per account.

billing-bot: created BILL-3245 to hold provisional credits for acct acme-prod.

sasha: thanks. I'll attach full logs to the ticket and monitor. 

ravi: add adapter audit for hidden retries (could be another dup source).

maia: I'll own billing schema PR and console mock. leo router patch. ravi metrics/reconcile/e2e.

sasha: checklist: [ ] router X-Toolcall-Id + orig_session_id [ ] provisional billing flow [ ] reconcile job [ ] console UX [ ] metrics [ ] e2e

leo: opening RFC now.

sasha: closing when RFC + PRs posted.
